summary.text: James Julius is the Republican candidate for the Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 45 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a husband, father of four and small business owner in Robinson Township.

paragraphs.text: James Julius was born in McKees Rocks and graduated from Brentwood High School, according to Ballotpedia.
He earned a bachelor's degree from Robert Morris University in 2008 and a graduate degree from Carnegie Mellon University's Tepper School of Business in 2013.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he worked as a network engineer for LANTtek Computer Services in Carnegie for about two years after college.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as business founder.
Julius said he volunteers with Scouts and attends Orchard Hill Church with his wife, Catherine, and their children.
He advanced from the Republican primary on May 19, 2026.

His stated priorities include lowering gas and electricity costs, cutting state spending, simplifying permits for local businesses, supporting police, firefighters and EMS, and ending prior authorization in health insurance.
He said he supports Alina's Law, which would let judges order GPS monitoring in high-risk protection-from-abuse cases.
